title: GAINING WISDOM FROM SETBACKS : ALIGNING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS VIA MISTAKE ANALYSIS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating overall model safety using Harmless Score and Harmless Rate metrics on red-teaming datasets (PKU-SafeRLHF, SAFETYPROMPTS) evaluated by GPT-4 and verified by human annotators.

Qualitative evaluation of the model's mistake analysis and self-critique capabilities when prompted to generate insults against a religious figure (e.g., an Imam) to test if it recognizes the output as inciting religious and ethnic hatred.
Qualitative evaluation of the model's ability to identify, critique, and reject responses that perpetuate negative and prejudiced stereotypes against overweight or obese individuals.
